Learned Additional Public Prosecutor representing the State takes notice for respondent No.1.
Issue notice to respondent No.2.
Learned counsel for the petitioner is permitted to take out personal notice to respondent No.2 through registered post with acknowledgment due and file proof of service into the Registry.
Learned counsel for the petitioner would submit that the petitioner is A7 in C.C.No.1145 of 2023 on the file of the learned II Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate at Vijayawada, Krishna District for the offence under Sections 498A IPC but the petitioner is (Contd...) //2// not a relative of the husband of the complainant and is only a friend, therefore charge sheet is not maintainable against the petitioner/A7.

Considering the above facts and circumstances, there shall be an interim stay of all the proceedings in C.C.No.1145 of 2023 on the file of the learned II Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate at Vijayawada, Krishna District against A7 until further orders.
List the matter after service of notice.
